title: Beyond Static Visual Tokens: Structured Sequential Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2603.26737v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Current multimodal LLMs encode images as static visual prefixes and rely on text-based reasoning, lacking goal-driven and adaptive visual access. Inspired by human visual perception-where attention is selectively and sequentially shifted from the most informative regions to secondary cues-we propose Structural Sequential Visual CoT SSV-CoT. First, a question-relevant saliency map identifies and organizes key visual regions, explicitly modeling the spatial distribution of visual importance. Second, reasoning is performed following this discriminative order, inducing a curriculum-like semantic progression from primary to secondary cues. This method is trained end-to-end, using text cot and answer supervision, without relying on region-level annotations or specialized external tools. Experiments on diverse visual reasoning benchmarks show gains, validating structured and sequential visual cognition.

translated_title: 超越静态视觉标记：结构化序列视觉思维链推理
translated_abstract: 当前多模态大语言模型将图像编码为静态视觉前缀，并依赖基于文本的推理，缺乏目标驱动和自适应的视觉访问能力。受人类视觉感知的启发——注意力会有选择性地、按顺序地从信息量最大的区域转移到次要线索——我们提出了结构化序列视觉思维链（SSV-CoT）。首先，与问题相关的显著性图识别并组织关键视觉区域，显式建模视觉重要性的空间分布。其次，推理按照这种有辨别性的顺序进行，形成从主要线索到次要线索的课程式语义递进。该方法采用文本思维链和答案监督进行端到端训练，无需依赖区域级标注或专门的外部工具。在多样化视觉推理基准上的实验表明该方法取得了性能提升，验证了结构化和序列化视觉认知的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出SSV-CoT方法，通过问题相关的显著性图识别关键视觉区域，并按照从主要线索到次要线索的顺序进行推理，实现了无需区域级标注、可端到端训练的结构化序列视觉思维链推理。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SSV-CoT, which uses question-relevant saliency maps to identify key visual regions and performs reasoning in a discriminative order from primary to secondary cues, achieving structured sequential visual chain-of-thought reasoning trained end-to-end without region-level annotations.
